storeId.description: Stable id for the feature store (maps to PostGIS table jgis_store_<slug>).

tileUrlTemplate.description: MVT URL template with {z}/{x}/{y} for the live tipg baseline (usually jupytergis_core/tiles/collections/…). Prefixed with the Jupyter base URL at runtime. Append ?v= from baselineVersion for cache busting.

baselineVersion.description: Monotonic baseline version; bump after each fold and append as ?v= on tile requests.

projection.description: CRS for feature geometries (stored as EPSG:4326 GeoJSON).

attribution.description: Attribution for the feature store source.
